# Knowledge Base: hilbert-22-oq-01

Insights accumulated during research on this problem.

## Problem Understanding

This OQ asks how the one-dimensional uniformization theorem for Riemann surfaces generalizes to higher-dimensional complex manifolds. The parent problem is Hilbert 22, whose local metadata presents the classical sphere/complex-plane/unit-disk trichotomy for simply connected Riemann surfaces.

The local Hilbert22OQ01 Lean file frames the higher-dimensional replacements as Kodaira dimension, the Enriques-Kodaira classification of compact complex surfaces, Yau's Kahler-Einstein metric framework, Kobayashi hyperbolicity, and the minimal model program. This is evidence for the shape of the research question, not evidence that those theories have been fully formalized here.
